mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines (compared to baseline returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production indicates manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment regime (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), a slowdown in payroll growth below 0.2% monthly signals labor market softening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth slows to < 0.2% in a high-employment regime.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (INDPRO) indicates a manufacturing contraction, increasing recession concerns and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.
